title: Four Ledgers, Not One Score: Responsible Communication of LLM-Judge Calibration in Biomedical ML
abstract: arXiv:2609.15015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic perturbations appear to offer inexpensive calibration data for LLM evaluators in biomedical ML, where expert review is scarce. Yet a planted mutation key is neither a detector output nor automatically human ground truth. We formalize four distinct ledgers: planted perturbations, independent detector outputs, source-linked human dispositions, and human-added discoveries. We then audit the evaluation design, scoring code, read paths, and current human records of a private synthetic Japanese care-handoff workflow. The factory stored 69 planted error cards across 47 targets. Final review covers 22 targets and contains 22 confirmed imported proposals, 9 rejected proposals, and 79 human-added cards; only 3 reviewed targets are double annotated. Passing imported plant keys to a generic detector scorer yields 22/(22+9)=0.710 and 22/(22+79)=0.218. A direct audit identity shows that these values are proposal-confirmation yield and submit

translated_title: 四本台账而非一个分数：生物医学机器学习中LLM评审校准的负责任沟通
translated_abstract: 在专家评审稀缺的生物医学机器学习领域，合成扰动似乎能为LLM评估器提供廉价的校准数据。然而，预先植入的变异键既不是检测器输出，也不能自动等同于人工真值标注。我们形式化定义了四种不同的台账：预植入扰动、独立检测器输出、具有来源关联的人工处置记录，以及人工新增的发现。随后，我们审计了一个私有的合成日语护理交接工作流的评估设计、评分代码、读取路径及当前的人工记录。该工厂存储了涉及47个目标的69张预植入错误卡片。最终评审覆盖22个目标，包含22个已确认的导入提案、9个被拒绝的提案以及79张人工新增卡片；仅有3个被评审目标是双重标注的。将导入的预植入键传入通用检测器评分器，得到22/(22+9)=0.710和22/(22+79)=0.218。直接的审计恒等式表明，这些数值分别是提案确认产出率和提交……
tldr: 该论文指出预植入的合成变异键不能被当作检测器输出或人工真值，通过形式化“预植入扰动、检测器输出、人工处置、人工新增发现”四本台账并审计一个日语护理交接工作流，揭示了朴素评分会混淆不同指标而产生0.710与0.218两种截然不同的误导性结果，主张在生物医学机器学习中负责任地沟通LLM评审器的校准结果。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that planted synthetic perturbation keys are neither detector outputs nor human ground truth; by formalizing four distinct ledgers—planted perturbations, detector outputs, human dispositions, and human-added discoveries—and auditing a Japanese care-handoff workflow, it shows that naive scoring conflates different metrics to yield misleading estimates of 0.710 and 0.218, advocating responsible communication of LLM-judge calibration in biomedical ML.
